title: Fix Windows replay lifetime with gated Job Object ownership
body:
On native Windows, a verification leader that exits0 or7 can leave child solvers running after `run_command` returns. The exact current-main function fails the new retained-process-handle observer in both cases. Following PR2377's explicit Windows handoff, this change assigns a gated launcher to a kill-on-close Job Object before it may start the requested command, then terminates/reaps the job at success, failure, timeout or interrupted wait. Assignment failure leaves the command unstarted.

Eight native tests cover those boundaries, joined completion, parent-only cleanup mutations and assignment denial, and startup-hook isolation (including a flag-removal mutant and preserved verifier environment). CPython3.12.7 normal/optimized and3.14.5 native checks pass. Research unittest discovery passed72tests with3Linux-only skips before the focused startup-hook correction; all8final native tests pass; the selected source-binding baseline passes. See `docs/research/windows-replay-lifetime.md` for commands, OS contracts, evidence and remaining questions. The shared-runner CI invalidation policy is unchanged; local checks do not establish hosted CI or full mathematical replays.

Base `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision4; card `portable-replay`, scope `831cc1a3c8f9ff01b197`. Scoped override follows the live lifetime defect. PR2377 is pinned at `5d444eee7dedd997c6094776fbb32ed19831e241`; its pending POSIX fix is not imported. PR2452 (`5208ab2780550273b1d8933ff584ce7581fb242d`) covers the distinct live-leader timeout observer.

Ordinary Windows subprocess ownership only. Commands must join proof-relevant children and propagate errors. This is not a hostile-code sandbox, crash-atomic output proof, supplier improvement or new kappa. The implementation uses CPython's Windows Popen handle. POSIX behavior is unchanged.

Credit yssite for PR2377's diagnosis and handoff, Paul Romeo for the process-tree fixture lineage, and Douglas Colkitt/retained contributors for the runner. Prepared for **ywz65 with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance** in implementation, tests and writing. Independently reviewed by another agent; no human review claimed. Apache-2.0.
